items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution rights; current Woot terms restrict collection, product-listing use, prices, and derivatives. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; this alone is not a launch blocker. Revenue attribution is partial, with $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 not assignable to a site. Concrete blockers are authoritative Woot permission, human-counsel review, accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, attribution, and owner disposition. Exact decision: keep private, keep permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing read-only evidence work. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent exposure, affiliate use, advertising, or external permission request.

Tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed; 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not change launch state, production, tracking, credentials, configuration, monetization, alert scope, or outreach.
